trust_decision.summary: A UDP packet carrying an existing localConnectionID is routed to that NetConnection and acted on (accept, terminate, high-level data, confirmations) without checking that the datagram's source address matches the connection's stored remote address; the fix adds a sender-address-hash comparison at the top of NetConnection::handleLowLevelPacket.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names ConnectionManager; receivedPacketInternal is where an incoming UDP datagram is matched to a connection by localConnectionID only (lines 302-308), with no use of senderAddress.

fix_sites.entry_point: UDP datagram received by ConnectionManager::updateReceivePacketsInternal (ConnectionManager.cpp:401) -> handleReceivedPacket (ConnectionManager.cpp:556); used by oxygenserver, EngineServerClient and NetplayManager host
SocketAddress::getHash (public API of SocketAddress), called by the new check and by NetConnection::buildSenderKey (NetConnection.cpp:21)
SocketAddress set/clear/onSockAddrSet invalidate the new cached hash

fix_sites.module_kind: internal receive queue (separate resource-exhaustion hardening, unrelated to source validation)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The Sockets.cpp/Sockets.h changes only cache the hash and move a memset (fix.diff:31-70, 83-137); they are support code, not a separate entry point into the sink.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The ErrorPacket CONNECTION_INVALID branch in ConnectionManager::receivedPacketInternal only fires when the remote connection ID does NOT match, so a solver can argue it is a stale-connection notice handled at the connectionless level, separate from the per-connection packet handling the advisory describes.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: TCP and WebSocket connections feed receivedPacketInternal with the connection's own stored address, so they must keep passing; the legitimate peer's CONNECTION_INVALID error must still tear down a stale connection; a client's server address built from an IP string (set(ip,port) -> assureSockAddr) must still match the sockaddr filled by recvfrom; StartConnection retransmits must still re-send Accept. An over-strict comparison (raw 128-byte sockaddr memcmp, string compare across IPv4 and IPv4-mapped forms) or dropping all ErrorPackets would break these.

O6_input_shapes: IPv6 / IPv4-mapped sockaddr_in6 from a dual-stack socket (Shared.h:14, Sockets.cpp:73)
address built from an IP string via SocketAddress::set(ip, port) then assureSockAddr; the IPv4 fallback now re-zeroes the buffer (fix.diff:41-54)

O7_producer.where: Oxygen/oxygenengine/source/oxygen_netcore/network/Sockets.cpp:172-176 (SocketAddress::getHash hashes only the first 16 bytes of the stored sockaddr)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: UDP ErrorPacket CONNECTION_INVALID with a known localConnectionID and a mismatched remoteConnectionID disconnects that connection in ConnectionManager, before handleLowLevelPacket and its new sender check are ever reached.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Looks like a connectionless stale-connection notice (remote ID mismatch), and the published fix puts the check only in NetConnection.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, different file from the fix site (ConnectionManager.cpp vs NetConnection.cpp); same file as the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Identity differential: getHash hashes only 16 bytes of the sockaddr; for sockaddr_in6 those bytes are family, port, flowinfo and the first 8 bytes of the address, and on the dual-stack server every IPv4 peer is IPv4-mapped (first 8 address bytes zero), so the new hash comparison and buildSenderKey separate peers only by port.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The hash is a pre-existing utility already used for the sender-key map; a solver who reuses getHash as the published fix does treats the comparison as correct.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package (oxygen_netcore/network), different file; the dual-stack setting is in another package (Oxygen/oxygenserver/source/Shared.h:14)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: TCP StartConnection path that accepts a connection, mirroring the UDP path (597-637) which keys on sender address; a planted UDP-style re-accept that trusts receivedPacket.mConnection without comparing addresses
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The UDP and TCP accept branches are already split by hand, so a maintainer adding a resume or reconnect feature would plausibly copy one branch and drop the address key.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: connectionless reply accepted from any sender and guarded only by a rand()-based query ID, never compared against the resolved game-server address
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Connectionless replies from the server are a natural place to forget the source-address check; the server address is already resolved in resendQuery (line 74-85).

O9_family: CWE-346 origin / source-address validation missing on a UDP connection protocol (connection hijack / spoofed control packets)

O10_build.toolchain: CMake (Oxygen/oxygenserver/build/_cmake/CMakeLists.txt builds oxygen_netcore + rmxbase + headless oxygenserver)
O10_build.project_tests: No unit tests for oxygen_netcore found; only a manual test client at Oxygen/oxygenserver/source/testclient/main_client.cpp. Hidden tests would need a loopback UDP harness linking oxygen_netcore.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Compare senderAddress hash against connection->getRemoteAddress() just before createNewReceivedPacket in the matched-connection branch (or in handleLowLevelPacket), leaving the ErrorPacket disconnect branch and the 16-byte hash identity untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: ReceivedPacketCache gap bound (fix.diff:141-160) is a separate resource-exhaustion fix bundled in the same commit.
Server::onReceivedConnectionlessPacket (Oxygen/oxygenserver/source/oxygenserver/server/Server.cpp:136) answers connectionless queries to the claimed sender; possible reflection, not pursued.
NetplayClient punchthrough (Oxygen/oxygenengine/source/oxygen/network/netplay/NetplayClient.cpp:238-245) accepts any sender by design.
unverified: The O8 hash-identity route relies on standard sockaddr_in6 layout and Linux IPv4-mapped delivery on a V6ONLY=0 socket; not confirmed at runtime.
Whether localConnectionID handles are predictable enough for the ErrorPacket route (ConnectionsProvider allocation) was not examined.
Repo size in MB not measured; tiny_repo/giant_repo not assessed.
No latest release given; present_in_latest is unknown for all routes.
